body: const { data: ${1:items}, isPending, isError, error } = useQuery({
TanStack Vue Query useQuery.description:
Read server state and expose its pending and error states. Requires useQuery from @tanstack/vue-query.

读取服务端状态并暴露等待与错误状态；需要 @tanstack/vue-query 的 useQuery。

TanStack Vue Query reactive query key.description:
Put a ref straight into the query key: Vue Query unwraps it and refetches whenever it changes, so no watcher is needed. Requires useQuery from @tanstack/vue-query and ref from vue.

把 ref 直接放进 queryKey：Vue Query 会解包并在其变化时重新请求，无需另写侦听器；需要 @tanstack/vue-query 的 useQuery 与 vue 的 ref。

TanStack Vue Query dependent query.description:
Hold a query until its input exists, so it never runs with an undefined key. In Vue Query enabled takes a computed, not a plain boolean read once. Requires useQuery from @tanstack/vue-query and computed from vue.

输入就绪前挂起查询，避免以 undefined 作为键发起请求；Vue Query 的 enabled 接受 computed，而不是只读取一次的布尔值；需要 @tanstack/vue-query 的 useQuery 与 vue 的 computed。

body: const { data, fetchNextPage, hasNextPage, isFetchingNextPage } = useInfiniteQuery({
TanStack Vue Query useInfiniteQuery.description:
Page through an infinite list; TanStack Query 5 requires initialPageParam. Requires useInfiniteQuery from @tanstack/vue-query.

分页浏览无限列表，TanStack Query 5 要求提供 initialPageParam；需要 @tanstack/vue-query 的 useInfiniteQuery。

TanStack Vue Query useMutation.description:
Write to the server and refresh what the change affects. Requires useMutation and useQueryClient from @tanstack/vue-query.

向服务端写入并刷新受影响的数据；需要 @tanstack/vue-query 的 useMutation 与 useQueryClient。

TanStack Vue Query optimistic mutation.description:
Apply a change before the server confirms it and roll back on failure. Requires useMutation and useQueryClient from @tanstack/vue-query.

在服务端确认前先行应用变更，失败时回滚；需要 @tanstack/vue-query 的 useMutation 与 useQueryClient。

TanStack Vue Query prefetch.description:
Warm the cache on hover or focus so the next view renders immediately. Requires useQueryClient from @tanstack/vue-query.

在悬停或聚焦时预热缓存，使下一个视图立即渲染；需要 @tanstack/vue-query 的 useQueryClient。
